digest.component_or_area: repository-level vocabulary enforcement and migration tooling
propositions: Deprecated 'Success Criteria' vocabulary must be removed from live prose in completion.py, test_completion_verifier.py, and sample-ticket-log.jsonl and replaced with 'Acceptance Criteria'
A count-pinned allowlist must specify exact phrase matches and bare-token occurrences across the repository with validation that actual counts match pinned counts

A deterministic guard script must scan the repository excluding archive/experiments/vendor/cache directories and enforce the allowlist, failing on count drift, malformed entries, duplicate paths, or unallowlisted vocabulary
The guard must be integrated into the root Makefile lint target so local and CI checks are identical
Four permanent semantic carve-outs and migration evidence must be explicitly allowlisted and remain accepted only at their documented counts

Bare tokens 'SC' and 'SCs' are only allowed in scoped paths (src/rebar/llm/reviewers/, src/rebar/_guides/, .rebar/criteria_routing.json, and generated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md) and must fail if injected elsewhere
